Google Ads Transparency uses any-time domain queries; a zero-result view is not proof of no activity, and an individual creative is attributed only when its named advertiser and visible brand content support the tie. Deliciae's verified advertiser creative was removed and is archive evidence; La Pino'z creative names the brand under verified advertiser COPENHAGEN HOSPITALITY but its last-shown date is not a current-active label. The Kind's email was visible in an official-domain indexed page but not in direct page extraction, so re-open that page before sending. UTK's email is for catering enquiries only. No private spend, ROAS, CPA, conversion, booking, order, audience, tag/pixel presence or event-firing measurement is claimed. No simulated, estimated, benchmarked, forecast or expected-uplift values are included.

United Telugu Kitchens' gm@telugukitchens.com is published on the brand's catering page for catering enquiries. It is not represented as a restaurant-marketing or paid-media contact.
Customer-care, general-query, order-support and catering inboxes are routing contacts only. No media decision-maker is identified for any retained lead.
Private account data, spend, ROAS, CPA, conversion rates, booking/order outcomes, tracking configuration, tag/pixel presence and event firing were not accessed or inferred.
